name: Throw
command: try { const actor=game.fdern.selectedActor(); const item=actor.items.filter(i=>i.system.actions?.includes("throw")).sort((a,b)=>Number(b.system.readied)-Number(a.system.readied))[0]??null; await game.fdern.act(actor, "throw", item); } catch(error) { ui.notifications.error(error.message); }
